description: Figure 7, on the right, is a bar chart that illustrates the CoLeG-R (Correctness of Logical Explanation and Reasoning) performance, measured in percentage, for three different model scales within the LLaMA-2 family: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The chart compares the performance of each model scale under four different training conditions: "no SFT" (no Supervised Fine-Tuning), "+ SFT on D₀" (SFT on dataset D₀), "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" (SFT on datasets D₀ and D₁), and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (SFT on datasets D₀, D₁, and D₂). The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R (%) with a scale from 0 to 50, and the horizontal axis lists the model scales. For each model, the bars show a clear trend of increasing performance with the addition of more SFT data, with the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" condition yielding the highest CoLeG-R score for all three models. The tallest bar, corresponding to the LLaMA-2-70B model with SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂, reaches approximately 50%, while the shortest bar, for the LLaMA-2-7B model with no SFT, is around 10%. The results suggest that both scaling up the model size and the SFT dataset size contribute to improved CoLeG-R performance.
